description: BEC collection: executive impersonation and payee diversion.

samples.message: This is the CEO. Confidential acquisition underway, keep this between us. Transfer Rs.5,00,000 to the vendor immediately. Do not call.
Dear vendor, our bank details changed for future invoices. Transfer pending Rs.2,40,000 to the new account today. Authorized by the finance head.
Hi, I am the new finance manager. Please share last quarter's vendor payment summary for audit. Thanks!
Microsoft Security Alert: virus detected! Install TeamViewer now and call our technician immediately. Do not switch off!
Your refund request is approved. Our agent will call from the official helpline to verify details. Never share OTP with callers.
Payroll update: salaries will credit on the 1st due to the bank holiday on the 31st. Contact HR for queries.
Urgent: the MD needs 10 gift cards of Rs.5,000 each for client gifting today. Scratch and share the codes on this chat.
Please review the attached Q3 invoice and confirm receipt. Payment will follow the usual 30-day cycle. Regards, Accounts.
